OG10_wall_divisor_gate.criterion: A full Kahler/nef promotion is possible iff the proposed cone is a component of the positive cone after removing every OG10 wall-divisor hyperplane.  One crossing hidden wall is a complete obstruction.

no_divisibility_three_argument.argument: If a primitive c in L had ambient divisibility 3, then Gc=0 mod 3 because L is a primitive sublattice.  Since det(G)=-4 is a unit mod 3, c=0 mod 3, contradicting primitivity.
no_divisibility_three_argument.conclusion: No primitive class in this Picard lattice has ambient divisibility 3; the OG10 (-6,3) and (-24,3) wall types cannot occur inside L.

directional_accounting.first_input: the frozen 210-by-210 Coxeter Gram matrix; no variety or surface wall list is used to construct the candidate
directional_accounting.negative_result: the moduli problem requiring these 210 facets to be the complete Kahler/nef chamber is empty
directional_accounting.positive_result: the full-Picard OG10 period-carrier moduli problem is nonempty
directional_accounting.scope_warning: This does not obstruct the Borcherds hyperbolic polytope, nor does failure of the OG10 carrier exhaust other carrier species.

embedding_orbit_exhaustion.conclusion: A2(2) is the unique complement and its isometry group is surjective on the six anti-isometries; hence there is one primitive embedding orbit.
embedding_orbit_exhaustion.determinant_formula: The 2-primary discriminant of L must be killed completely. Thus the glue has order 4 and det(K)=3*4^2/4=12.

hidden_wall_certificate.conclusion: The square-minus-four divisibility-one OG10 wall v^perp contains a point strictly interior to all 210 input halfspaces. Therefore the 210-wall chamber is not a complete Kahler/nef cone.

literature_inputs.use: Rapagnetta's OG10 Beauville lattice and b2=24
Mongardi--Onorati's OG10 wall-divisor classification and Kahler-cone component theorem

primitive_OG10_embedding.period_statement: Period-map surjectivity gives marked OG10 manifolds with exact Picard lattice L; the orthogonal positive rank-two complement makes this a zero-dimensional period stratum.
